note: Alberta Parks recreation area on the eastern slopes near Coleman (Crowsnest Pass), off Hwy 40 on Dutch Creek Road. The River Loop's south-side sites sit beside Dutch Creek; sites 2-11 and 24-28 are let as seasonal sites. No firewood for sale; the hand pump is for putting out fires only. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Apr 24, 2026) and the July 2026 campground map: C$26 unserviced, first-come only, season May 8 - Oct 1, 30 nightly sites, no services, vault toilets, non-potable pump; seasonal program (15 sites, C$19/night for 90-140 nights) added to fees.note. Creekside confirmed on 2017 Wayback imagery (River Loop south-side sites ~10-20 m from the creek). Phone 403-627-1165 suggested. Seniors line present.
flags: PHONE (stored empty): the page's 'Information: 403-627-1165'. No 'Facility Operator' line on the page. Recommend 403-627-1165.
WEBSITE: stored camping page answered 200 and is this campground.

SITES: page table 'Unserviced 30' plus a separate 'Seasonal Camping: 15 basic sites'; the July 2026 map numbers sites 1-43 with 'Seasonal campsites are sites #2-11 and 24-28' (15), which would leave 28 nightly sites. Kept count 30 (the page's nightly figure); the map suggests 28. Nightly share is well over 1 in 10, so the seasonal program is no long-stay problem.
SENIORS LINE: present ('This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.').

WATERFRONT (stored creekside, CONFIRMED): the current Esri World Imagery (WV02 2016-09-15) is shadowed and shows no water, but the Esri Wayback release 2017-06-14 at z18 (0.39 m/px) shows Dutch Creek (~10-15 m wide, turbid, a log jam on a gravel bar) curving along the south edge of the River Loop. The loop road runs ~10-15 m north of the creek bank between ~49.9035,-114.3985 and 49.9037,-114.3965, with grass and scattered conifers (no continuous treeline) between the road and the water; RVs are parked on the south-side spurs ~12-20 m from the water. The map puts the River Loop's south-side sites (about 14, 16, 17, 20, 21, 23) between the loop road and the creek, so the loop road does not separate them from the water. Creek width under ~30 m -> creekside, not riverfront. The page itself calls it 'a peaceful riverside campground'.

PIN (49.9034,-114.3968): on the creek's north bank at the River Loop, ~90 m SE of the campground's centre (~49.9041,-114.3975 on the 2017 imagery); the page's directions point 49.904181,-114.39963 is the Inside Loop's west end. Under 250 m, no move.
